fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: Used as a boolean: the update bg3.exe+0x1D51750 (query {ls::VisualComponent, this, eoc::TimelineActorDataComponent}) passes it to bg3.exe+0x1D51B60, which calls the visibility-request helper bg3.exe+0x426C9A0 with visible = (field_0 == 0) for every matching attached effect. Not initialised by the add-or-get helper bg3.exe+0x6D4580 (live instances hold 01/02/05/10/FF.. - partly garbage), so kept as uint8_t. Which state it stands for (playing / hidden) was not established.

fields.name: AnimationName
fields.evidence: Created as invalid (0xFFFFFFFF) by bg3.exe+0x6D4580 (all 21 live instances hold 0xFFFFFFFF). bg3.exe+0x1D51B60 compares it with +0x30 of the ls::EffectComponent of each entity attached to the dummy visual (attachment flag bit 10); +0x30 is EffectComponent::AnimationName in Script Extender's Effect.h. Only effects with an equal name get the visibility request.

open_questions: Meaning of field_0 and who writes field_0 / AnimationName: no writer was found through the type index (the writer reaches the component through a query pointer).

The probe shows byte 1 with values other than 0/1 on some instances (00/02/14/74), although the constructor writes 0 - either garbage from a creation path that does not run the constructor or the field is wider than a bool.
